hooks.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); node "$r/bin/vstack.mjs" hook pre-edit --harness codex || exit 2'
sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); node "$r/bin/vstack.mjs" hook post-edit --harness codex'

sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); node "$r/bin/vstack.mjs" hook stop --harness codex || printf "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"Veristack stop hook failed closed\"}\n"'
